notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (FY2025 Form 20-F on sec.gov). IFRS, US$. Income tax paid is inside OCF; interest paid (26) is in financing and is added; interest received (171) is in investing, so it does not lower OCF. OCF (79) is depressed by the financial-services loan book growth (691 outflow), partly offset by banking-business customer deposits (308 inflow): flagged, not adjusted, and material (net −0.383bn vs paidOut 3.440bn). Revenue is after partner and consumer incentives (partner 1,002 and consumer 1,268 in 2025), so incentives paid to drivers and merchants are not in revenue or in paidOut; driver and merchant earnings in Grab's agent-model businesses are captured in salesEnabled instead.
